nodes.label: Dark Mode State & ClearColor Architecture
nodes.rationale: Manage darkMode boolean state (default true) in Scene.tsx, sync to Three.js via buildDesk's setDarkMode, use gl.setClearColor(0x070709, 1) in Dark mode and gl.setClearColor(0x000000, 0) in Light mode so .scene radial-gradient shows through, and use .hud class so raycast ignores clicks.

nodes.label: GLTF Loading & Raycast Mitigation
nodes.rationale: Store darkMode ref/flag in DeskSetup.ts and apply after GLTF models load; add hud class to toggle container so onUp raycast ignores it.
